performance.verdict: Meta is the only active lead engine; Google and SOW delivery are both stalled.

findings.text: 5 overdue SOW milestones (due 2026-07-31 to 2026-08-01): Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, Meta Retargeting — none completed per event log.
Meta delivered all 12 28-day leads at CPL $53.47/lead on $641.67 spend; Google spent $1,707.77 and logged only 7 conversions — Meta is 3x more efficient per dollar.
3-day lead signal accelerating: Sep 8–10 averaged 2.3 leads/day vs Sep 5–7 average of 1.0 — all from Meta; Google spend on Sep 9 was $268.11 but contributed 0 tracked leads those 3 days.
GBP actions dropped 100% to 0 for Sep 8–10 vs prior 3-day average of 1.7 — organic local presence has gone dark in the same window leads are rising.
GHL shows 60 opportunities created but 0 won, 0 appointments, and GA4 records 0 conversions — 12 ad leads are not progressing to consults; intake pipeline is the leak, not ads.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; LSA and tracking gaps are blocking Google attribution and launch.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones due 2026-07-31 through 2026-08-01 remain incomplete: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site & Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting Launch. These block proper Google/LSA attribution and mean $1,707.77 in Google spend is running without confirmed conversion tracking. Nacer must confirm completion dates for each item by 2026-09-14. Success check: all 5 items marked complete with verified event in the SOW log.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake flow: 60 opps created, 0 appointments booked — leads arriving but no consults converting; audit routing and speed-to-lead.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 60 opportunities created in the 28-day window with 0 appointments and 0 won deals, meaning every inbound lead is stalling at intake — this is not an ads problem. Audit the routing rules, auto-reply triggers, and calendar/booking links built per the Month 1 SOW. Target: at least 1 confirmed booked appointment per 3 leads within 7 days of fix. Re-check GHL appointment count on 2026-09-18.

suggestions.text: Shift $15/day from Google Search to Meta; Meta CPL is confirmed lower and 3-day lead signal is rising.

The 3-day signal (Sep 8–10) shows Meta averaging 2.3 leads/day, up from 1.0. Move $15/day from Google Ads to Meta — a shift of roughly 13% of current daily Google budget.
